verdict.rationale: For card-based agentic checkout, Skyfire documents cardholder consent: an authorization covers a specific merchant and amount, and "the agent/agent platform can never spend more than the cardholder approved." Its marketing also cites "user mandate collection." Wallet-funded pay/kya-pay tokens are different: the agent can create them on its own (including via MCP tools) from a pre-funded wallet, with no documented human confirmation step. Their only bounds are the committed amount and the expiry. missing for 10: an approval or confirmation gate for wallet pay-token spending, configurable thresholds that mark spending as sensitive and require consent, a per-token revocation API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the consent flow.
